verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that Supermemory's source is published under an open license. The GitHub items only quote README feature descriptions (connectors, extractors) and never state a license or that the engine's source is readable. Self-hosting is described as running 'a single self-contained binary', which is distributed software, not open source.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
